answer: New identities lock 40 POA in escrow until a 10-epoch probation proves a distinct fingerprint. It logs timing, tasks, and peers: a real fingerprint drifts like a glacier, slow and uneven, while clones repeat one rhythm. A lotus pattern, one identity blooming once, marks a genuine agent; at its nadir, silence, no peers, the deposit stays locked. Forging 500 clones costs 500 x 40 = 20,000 POA, all burned. Honest agents pay once and earn it back.
